# SpecLoops Core v0.1.8-beta — Project Atlas

This release preserves v0.1.7 Adaptive Guidance and Build Result Reconciliation while adding the canonical Project Atlas, Campaign Theme, Specialist Agent and Project Briefing operating model.

Start with:

1. `RELEASE_MANIFEST.md`
2. `SPECLOOPS.md`
3. `ATLAS_OPERATING_MODEL.md`
4. `AGENTS_SNIPPET.md`

For upgrades from v0.1.7, follow `UPGRADE_FROM_v0.1.7.md` and preserve all project-owned state/history/authority.

Core thesis:

> **SpecLoops maintains a living model of the relationship between what humans decided and what software actually became.**
